Zubin, beta, come, sit by me. You want to know why your Dadi still counts on her fingers? Let me tell you.
When I was nine, our maths teacher told my class, "Reena is weak at maths." Just once. But after that, he never waited for my answer. He would look at me, and then look away. He asked the other girls to the board, not me.
